chunks.text:
[The Lanterns Gutter]
{starts low and close, not quiet: the creeping chromatic bass ostinato alone, a ticking hi-hat joins, organ stabs creep in, then the full band slams into the theme}
positive_styles: cold minor-key sawtooth lead melody with tritone leaps
tight sampled drums with tom-heavy fills
uneasy dark battle theme, solemn and sorrowful rather than evil
full band arrives with the theme
